role: VALIDATION CHECK of the FROZEN v2 representation (configs/eci_v2/representation.json) on a public benchmark; no knob is tuned here

data.note: CRIM13 top view, 236 videos (103 released train / 133 released test), Norpix .seq of 8-bit grey JPEGs, 640 x 480 (151) or 656 x 490 (85), 25 fps; dense S1 frame labels (scripts/benchmark/crim13/align_common.py)

plan_note: the frame plan of the CRIM13 alignment test (scripts/benchmark/crim13/align_plan.py, rng 0), reused unchanged: 5 fps grid v % 5 == 0, v >= 50; per released half 10,000 'train' + 2,000 'calib' label-free pool frames and 15,000 'eval' frames stratified by label with inverse-probability weights w

geometry.canvas: align_common.canvas_gpu: the grey frame (3 channels) PADDED to a W x W square in the ImageNet mean colour; 656-wide canvases resized to 640 (bicubic, antialias, x 0.976 = a downscale); 640-wide videos at native size
geometry.rule: native side (640 = a multiple of 16), never upsampled; the 85 videos of width 656 are downscaled to 640 so every frame shares the 40 x 40 grid of the previous CRIM13 arms (identical encoder input frames to arms B0-B7 / C1-C4)

canonical: none (no layout prior on CRIM13: the cage has no fixed odour corner / side; spec 'others none')

mask.rule: TIGHT (spec): token kept iff >= 25% (src/eci/v2/mask.THR) of its 16 x 16 canvas patch are animal pixels; animal pixel = grey < 60 AND bg - grey > 40, bg = per-pixel median grey of 32 evenly spaced frames of the video (the pixel cue of the CRIM13 'dark' mask of scripts/benchmark/crim13/align_encode.py); NO DINOv2 token cue, NO dilation; padding cells never kept
mask.check: released track points (resident / intruder by strain): own cell kept; never used to build the mask

sae_pool.eval_fve: test half, role 'calib' (2,000 frames of held-out videos, label-free; held-out FVE for the deployment seed)
sae_pool.note: ONE dictionary trained on train-split videos only (spec: one SAE per domain); it is used for both scoring directions

readout.frame: max over kept tokens of the theta* token codes (src/eci/v2/sae.frame_codes)
readout.smooth: centred mean over the 5 fps grid frames v - 5, v, v + 5 (25 fps source; 0.6 s window, truncated at the video end) = src/eci/v2/readout.smooth h 1
readout.fire: not used: R~ / AUROC rank the smoothed codes directly

score.halves: the released train / test halves; direction A = pick on the train half's eval frames, score on the test half's; B = swapped
score.metric: weighted (inverse-probability w) statistics of scripts/benchmark/crim13/align_train.align_w2 / pick_and_test; R~ = (R-precision - pi) / (1 - pi) of the R-precision-picked neuron, pi = the scoring half's weighted base rate; AUROC of the AUROC-picked neuron
